Header.title: Auturo
Header.paragraph: Drive with style, drive with Auturo – your go-to brand for bringing uniqueness to your vehicle.

About.paragraph: At Auturo, we believe that every car has a personality waiting to shine. Our unique rear window decorations let you express your style, enhance your vehicle’s look, and make every drive more fun.

Services.name: Can I customize the background picture?
Services.text: We sell the decoration as a complete set and offer various background options. However, you're welcome to replace it with any custom background of your choice by printing your own design.

Services.name: How do I turn the lights on and off?
Services.text: The lights will automatically turn on when the vehicle’s power is on and turn off when the power is off, making it easy and convenient to use.

Services.name: What is the return policy?
Services.text: Your satisfaction is our top priority. We offer a 30-day, no-questions-asked return policy, and we sincerely hope you’ll enjoy this unique decoration for your vehicle.

Testimonials.text: "The installation is quite simple. The car's trunk has a cigarette lighter, making it very convenient to hide the wiring."

"It's energy-efficient and eco-friendly, which makes me feel at ease. No wiring is needed, so there’s no risk of electrical short circuits."
"It looks great! The camera doesn't capture the actual look. It looks even better in person."
"It looks really great and I love it! It's so easy for girls to install, and it definitely attracts attention on the street."

Features.title: Step 1
Features.text: Peel off the adhesive tape and place the attachment securely in the rear window of your vehicle.

Features.title: Step 2
Features.text: Attach any preferred decorative items to the background board using the provided glue or adhesive.

Features.title: Step 3
Features.text: Plug the power cable into your vehicle’s cigarette lighter socket.
